description: Use this only as the entry point for the interactive intake form, or when the user attaches a pitch file such as .eml or .msg. For a pitch pasted in chat, use score_message instead. With no message it returns status ready and the empty form. With a message it returns status ok, the evaluation and three reply drafts. It saves the evaluation only when the user already has a desk; otherwise it scores against a sample engineer profile, which is not the user's real score, so say so and offer set_criteria. The desk is the signed-in user's, so send no desk_key.

examples.message: Hi, we are hiring a Staff Engineer at Stripe, $220k base, remote.

channel.description: Optional channel the pitch came from. Defaults to email.

file.description: Set by ChatGPT when the user opens an attached pitch file (.eml, .msg, .pitch, .outreach). Do not fill it yourself.

resourceUri.description: The host link to the file.

message.description: Optional pitch text, such as "Hi, we are hiring a Staff Engineer at Stripe, $220k base, remote." Omit it to open the empty intake form.

priority.description: Optional priority the user gives this pitch. Defaults to medium.

sender.description: Optional sender email address, profile URL or domain, such as "jane@stripe.com".

name: intake_message

as_of.description: Day of the call, as YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

drafts.description: Only with status ok: one draft body for each kind of reply. Nothing is sent.

decline.description: Draft body for a polite decline, with the feedback card appended.

interested.description: Draft body for an interested reply.

request_info.description: Draft body that asks for the salary range and remote policy.

evaluation.description: Only with status ok: the score of the pitch.

breakdown.description: The four sub-scores, each an integer from 0 to 100 where higher is better.

cadence.description: How well spaced the outreach is; low for rapid follow-ups or contact after a decline.

relevance.description: Fit with the target role, skills, salary floor and remote policy.

spam.description: Spam safety: 100 is clean, low means template tokens, buzzwords or urgency.

specificity.description: How concrete the pitch is: named company, role details and stated salary.

evaluation_id.description: Id to pass to draft_response; valid only when the user has a desk.

flags.description: Warning flags. Values: missing_salary, dealbreaker_clash, token_failure (unfilled template token such as [Current Company]), aggressive_drip, repeat_after_decline, slop, artificial_urgency, free_webmail. Empty when the pitch is clean.

file.description: The attached file, when the form was opened from one.

resourceUri.description: The host link to the file, as ChatGPT sent it.

message.description: With status ready: what the user should do next. With status ok: which criteria the pitch was scored against.

priority.description: Priority the user gave the pitch.

scored_against.description: your_criteria: the user's saved desk criteria. sample_profile: a sample engineer profile, because the user has no desk; this is not the user's real score.

source.description: Where the data comes from: the user's own private desk.

status.description: ready: the empty form is open and no pitch was given. ok: the pitch was scored.

title: Inbound Message Intake
